title: Atrium Livings | Home Decor & DIY Magazine
tagline: Your Inspiring Digital Magazine for Home Decor, DIY Projects & Creative Living
description: Atrium Livings is an inspiring home decor and DIY magazine offering creative decor ideas, hands-on DIY tutorials, interior styling guides, and home improvement inspiration.

categories.name: Kitchen
categories.title: Kitchen Decor, Cabinetry & DIY Styling
categories.description: Explore kitchen styling ideas, open shelving, cabinet makeovers, marble accents, and functional DIY kitchen organization.

categories.name: Bathroom
categories.title: Bathroom Decor, Tile Ideas & Spa Styling
categories.description: From small powder room makeovers to tranquil bath retreats, discover stylish tile accents, vanity decor, and spa-inspired touches.

categories.name: Living Room
categories.title: Living Room Decor, Cozy Styling & Furniture Layouts
categories.description: Curate warm, welcoming living rooms with cozy seating arrangements, gallery walls, ambient lighting, and stylish decor.

categories.name: Bedroom

categories.name: Furniture

categories.name: Lighting

categories.name: Renovation

categories.name: DIY

authors.name: Sarah Mitchell
authors.bio: Sarah is an interior stylist and home decor editor with over 16 years of experience in residential decoration, home staging, and modern interior styling across New York and London.

authors.name: James Harper
authors.bio: James specializes in hands-on DIY projects, woodworking, furniture builds, and practical home improvements. He shares clear, accessible guides for homeowners tackling their own renovations.

authors.name: Olivia Bennett
authors.bio: Based between Chicago and Paris, Olivia curates decorative objects, vintage flea market finds, textile styling, and contemporary home accents for high-end residences.
